AlexNet's jump was not incremental. It was a break: more data, more compute, and GPUs as the training engine broke a trajectory of slow improvement that had been stuck for decades.
replacements.Antes del salto, el error en ImageNet me: Before the jump, ImageNet error was improving slowly. AlexNet reduced it by roughly forty percent in a single year.
replacements.Eje: % error top-5 en ImageNet. Menos es: Axis: ImageNet top-5 error (%). Lower is better. AlexNet cut the error by about 10 percentage points at once, after years of 1–2 point improvements.
replacements.Tres piezas convergieron al mismo tiempo: Three pieces converged at the same time. No single one would have been sufficient.
replacements.ImageNet: 1,2 millones de imágenes etiqu: ImageNet: 1.2 million labeled images. The training-data scale was incomparably larger than what had been available in earlier years.
replacements.Dos GPUs GTX 580. Las GPUs paralelizaban: Two GTX 580 GPUs. GPUs parallelized thousands of operations at once, turning weeks of CPU work into days of training.
replacements.Red convolucional profunda con ReLU, dro: A deep convolutional network with ReLU, dropout, and max-pooling. Each layer learned more abstract representations than the one before it.
replacements.El mensaje no fue \"AlexNet ganó ImageNe: The message was not "AlexNet won ImageNet." It was that more data + more compute + better representations can produce predictable improvements.
replacements.Visión artificial = ingeniería manual de: Computer vision = hand-engineered features (SIFT, HOG, LBP…). Each domain required different experts.
replacements.La red aprende las características por s: The network learns features directly from raw data. The same paradigm can be applied across vision, audio, text, and more.
replacements.El cambio de régimen no fue técnico: fue: The regime shift was not just technical; it was epistemological. Data and compute became the dominant levers.
